The sentence is ungrammatical and does not clearly state the location and time meanings of nach.

validations.reason: The German example is present tense, but the Czech translation incorrectly uses the past tense.

The current sentence is ungrammatical and incorrectly describes bringen using an adjective instead of the verb.

validations.reason: Ob introduces an indirect yes/no question and does not mean „nebo“ as a coordinating conjunction.
Same production defect as HIGH-293: ob is translated as „Nebo“ instead of an indirect-question meaning.
„Popř.“ means „possibly/alternatively“ and is not the Czech translation of ob in an indirect question.

validations.reason: The comparison incorrectly gives ob the meaning „Nebo“ instead of „zda/jestli“ in an indirect question.
„Popř.“ does not express the standard Czech meaning of oder, which is „nebo“.
validations.currentCs: V češtině oder nejčastěji znamená popř.

validations.reason: Same production defect as HIGH-296: ob is incorrectly rendered as „Nebo v nepřímé otázce“.

Stehen means „slušet“ for clothing and „stát“ literally; the current text omits the clothing meaning.
